name: WARNING: Airport Hudson News Dried Fruit Medley (Sorbitol & Insoluble Skins)
whyItWorks: Bags of dried apricots, prunes, and apples. Dense in natural sorbitol (sugar alcohol) and concentrated leathery fruit skins. Triggers explosive gas distension and laxative effects at altitude.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid dried fruit bags at airport newsstands. Choose fresh peeled bananas or smooth applesauce pouches.
